description: ACM's acmart (CTAN, v2.20 of 2026/08/16, from MiKTeX 9766) in its acmtog format, the two-column journal layout of ACM Transactions on Graphics, which also prints the SIGGRAPH and SIGGRAPH Asia journal-track papers (conference-track papers use sigconf). acmtog is a journal format (acmart.cls l.231-233): 9pt type (l.271-272), a US-letter page with 52pt margins and a 24pt column gap (l.643-649), and the page turns two-column at \maketitle (l.2436), as sigconf's does. Its footers print '\@journalNameShort, Vol. \@acmVolume, No. \@acmNumber, Article \@acmArticle' (l.3063-3078), so, as for acmart-acmsmall, the preamble names the journal (TOG, a valid \acmJournal key: 'ACM Trans. Graph.', l.1414-1418) and sample volume, number and article, instead of an empty journal name and 'Article .'; CCS concepts, keywords and affiliations are optional and left out. As for the other acmart settings: General's font and AMS lines are left out (omitPreamble), since under XeTeX acmart sets its maths with unicode-math (l.788-799) and General's lmodern after it took the maths fonts back to 8-bit Latin Modern; an empty \title gives the odd-page head the \shorttitle it prints (l.3070); and \settopmatter{printacmref=false} leaves out the ACM Reference Format block, whose inline full-width title overfilled the first page (ACM-REFLINE, fix-notes batch 1 round 3).
